title: Polish Franka workbench assets, upload and layout
goal: Improve the merged Robot Capture Franka workbench without changing its existing single-arm capture behavior: replace the Piper visual model with a valid FR3 visual model, validate upload readiness, and migrate root configuration and launcher layout compatibly.
doneWhen: The arm viewer loads a valid FR3 model with matching seven-joint telemetry mapping.
Upload behavior is verified against an operator-provided writable destination or its environment blocker is precisely documented.
Configuration, scripts, docs and tests use the canonical clean layout, and an explicit migration tool updates previously installed entry points.
Existing single-arm two-camera capture and teleoperation behavior remain unchanged.
decisions: User deferred the third-camera UI change. The active single-arm configuration remains exactly two cameras.
Discovery found an FR3 URDF at RLinf-Franks/rlinf_ext/assets/fr3.urdf, but its franka_description visual meshes are absent from that repository.

Canonical config and launchers now live exclusively under config/ and scripts/; root wrappers, root config links, and legacy Piper assets were removed from the root. scripts/migrate_layout.sh reinstalls old launcher/systemd entry points to their canonical paths.
Upload remains unchanged and disabled after probe: /mnt/nas/forge/franka/raw cannot be created by current user.
